Definition: a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set)
BiblicalUsage: Kir is a cooking range, two parallel stones with the boiler set across them. Leviticus 11:35 says that where a carcase falls, whether it be oven or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down, for they are unclean.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the range is broken, not washed, because some uncleanness goes too deep for scrubbing: what death has touched must come down.
